segments.name: Banking
segments.evidence: Busey Bank offers a range of diversified financial products and services for consumers and businesses, including online and mobile banking capabilities to conveniently serve its customers' needs.

segments.name: Wealth Management
segments.description: Provides asset management, investment, brokerage, fiduciary, tax and farm management services to individuals, businesses, and foundations.
segments.evidence: Busey Bank provides a full range of asset management, investment, brokerage, fiduciary, philanthropic advisory, tax preparation, and farm management services to individuals, businesses, and foundations through its Wealth Management business.

segments.name: FirsTech
segments.description: Delivers technology-enabled payment processing solutions to business clients across the United States, concentrated in financial services, utilities, insurance, and telecommunications.
segments.evidence: FirsTech, a wholly owned subsidiary of Busey Bank, delivers technology‑enabled payment processing solutions to business clients across the United States.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Corporate and other activities not attributable to the Banking, Wealth Management, or FirsTech segments.

revenueModel.text: Busey earns interest and fees on loans and investments, wealth management fees, service fees, and payment technology solutions revenue from its customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Busey Bank's principal sources of income are interest and fees on loans and investments, wealth management fees, service fees, and payment technology solutions revenue.

changes.text: In 2024, Busey acquired Merchants and Manufacturers Bank Corporation, adding Life Equity Loan products and expanding its suburban Chicago presence.
changes.evidence: On April 1, 2024, Busey completed its acquisition of M&M and its wholly-owned subsidiary, M&M Bank.
